newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber closes steady without trading.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber closes steady without trading.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted steady at the close, following a strong rebound in Tokyo, although the domestic market saw virtually no trading ahead of an MRELB dinner.
"They (the prices) are just following the higher Tokyo market," said a dealer, closing office early to join other traders and producers for the annual dinner in Kuala Lumpur.
The dinner caps a day-long meeting of senior officials in MRELB, leading to a banquet speech on new industry targets.

At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB) quoted market indicator price for November RSS1 buyer at 308.50 cents ($1.23) a kg, unchanged from Thursday. November SMR 20 was also unchanged at 306.50.
Traders offered the SMR 20 at 304 cents, SMR10 at 305, SMR 5 at 316, SMR L at 341, SMR CV at 361 and drum latex at 232.
The INRO five-day average was lower at 239.03 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Oct 24 from 238.93 on Oct 23. The daily indicator was higher at 239.28 against 238.96.
